title: Do not miss going to Cordoba
text: The mosque/cathedral was exquisite. Totally amazing. The free time was perfect.  Lots of narrow streets with quaint shops were interesting.  The guide did not speak good English.  She was difficult to understand. She was not sensitive to our needs.  The driver was absolutely perfect.  She was very professional and did a great job.
author: Sue_U

title: Excellent Córdoba Guide
text: Our tour of the Córdoba Mosque/Cathedral with Verónica was a highlight of our time in Spain. The history & architecture means so much to her, & she infuses her tour with so much knowledge & emotion. We really enjoyed our time with her. Nacho was our driver from Granada to Córdoba & back. He was a good driver, was punctual, & took care of us when there was an issue with the car on the way back.
author: Joanne_F
